consequence.statement: The v1beta1 and v2beta1 Flux APIs have been removed from the CRDs. Unless Flux Operator deploys the Flux controllers, operators must run `flux migrate` on clusters before upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Run `flux migrate` on each cluster before upgrading to Flux 2.7.0, and see the Flux v2.7 upgrade guide for details.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 removes the end-of-life v1beta1 and v2beta1 Flux APIs from its CRDs. Unless Flux Operator deploys the controllers, operators must run `flux migrate` on their clusters before upgrading.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence says the step applies to clusters that do not use Flux Operator. It does not name the affected CRDs or API groups, so a storedVersions predicate cannot be limited to Flux CRDs without inventing names. Flux Operator usage has no stated predicate either.
